query:
UPDATE services SET
  title = 'Septic Service and Repairs',
  shortDesc = 'A properly maintained septic system can last for decades. We provide preventative maintenance, inspections, and a full line of repairs and replacements for septic beds and sewers across London and Southwestern Ontario.',
  longDesc = 'Your septic system works silently underground every single day. When it is working well, you never think about it. When it fails, it becomes an urgent, expensive problem that affects your property, your family, and the environment around you.\n\nAt Discount Drain, we have been servicing septic systems across London and Southwestern Ontario since 1970. Our certified technicians handle everything from routine pump-outs and inspections to full septic bed replacements and sewer line repairs. Whether your system is showing early warning signs or you are dealing with a full backup, we diagnose the problem accurately and fix it the right way the first time.\n\nWe work on all types of septic systems including conventional systems, raised bed systems, and holding tanks. For commercial and rural properties, we also service larger-capacity systems and provide scheduled maintenance programs to keep your system compliant with Ontario regulations.\n\nEvery service call includes a thorough inspection of your tank, distribution box, and absorption field. We use camera inspection technology to identify cracks, root intrusion, and blockages before they turn into full failures. Our team will walk you through what we find and give you a clear, honest assessment of what needs to be done and what can wait.\n\nIf your septic bed has failed completely, we can design and install a new system that meets current Ontario Building Code requirements. We handle all permits, excavation, and installation with our own equipment and crew, so you deal with one company from start to finish.',
  benefits = '[{"title":"Free Camera Inspection Included","desc":"Every service call includes a free sewer and septic camera inspection, a $400 value at no charge to you."},{"title":"Full Repairs and Replacements","desc":"From minor repairs to complete septic bed replacements, we handle the entire job with our own crew and equipment."},{"title":"Ontario Regulation Compliant","desc":"All installations and repairs meet Ontario Building Code and local municipality requirements."},{"title":"Scheduled Maintenance Programs","desc":"We offer recurring maintenance plans for residential and commercial properties to prevent costly failures."},{"title":"24/7 Emergency Dispatch","desc":"Septic emergencies do not wait for business hours. Our emergency line is available around the clock, 365 days a year."},{"title":"Family-Owned Since 1970","desc":"Over 55 years of experience servicing septic systems in London and Southwestern Ontario."}]',
  faqs = '[{"q":"How do I know if my septic system needs to be pumped?","a":"Most residential septic tanks need to be pumped every 3 to 5 years depending on household size and usage. Signs that your tank is overdue include slow drains throughout the house, gurgling sounds in the plumbing, sewage odours near the tank or absorption field, and unusually lush or soggy patches of grass over the septic bed. If you notice any of these signs, call us for an inspection before the problem gets worse."},{"q":"What is the difference between a septic repair and a septic bed replacement?","a":"A septic repair addresses a specific component that has failed, such as a cracked tank, a blocked distribution box, a broken baffle, or a damaged outlet pipe. A septic bed replacement is needed when the absorption field itself has failed and can no longer treat effluent properly. Bed failure is usually caused by years of overloading, root intrusion, or soil compaction. We inspect the entire system to determine which option is appropriate before recommending any work."},{"q":"How long does a septic bed last in Ontario?","a":"A well-maintained conventional septic bed typically lasts 20 to 30 years in Ontario. Factors that shorten its lifespan include infrequent pump-outs, flushing non-biodegradable materials, heavy water usage, and tree roots growing into the distribution lines. Regular maintenance and inspections can significantly extend the life of your system."},{"q":"Do I need a permit to replace my septic system in Ontario?","a":"Yes. In Ontario, any new septic system installation or major repair requires a permit from your local municipality or the Conservation Authority. Discount Drain handles all permit applications and ensures every installation meets the Ontario Building Code requirements for your property size and soil conditions."},{"q":"Can you service commercial or rural septic systems?","a":"Yes. We service all types of septic systems including conventional residential systems, raised bed systems, holding tanks, and larger-capacity commercial systems. We also provide scheduled maintenance programs for farms, rural businesses, and commercial properties that rely on private sewage disposal."},{"q":"What areas do you serve for septic repairs?","a":"We serve London and the surrounding Southwestern Ontario region including Strathroy, St. Thomas, Woodstock, Tillsonburg, Ingersoll, Aylmer, Dutton, Glencoe, Parkhill, and Lucan. If you are unsure whether we cover your area, call us and we will let you know."},{"q":"How much does a septic repair cost in Ontario?","a":"Costs vary widely depending on the type and extent of the repair. A simple pump-out and inspection is much less expensive than a full bed replacement. We provide honest, upfront assessments and written estimates before any work begins. There are no surprise charges on your final invoice."},{"q":"What should I avoid putting into my septic system?","a":"Avoid flushing anything other than human waste and toilet paper. Do not put cooking grease, coffee grounds, medications, wipes (even those labelled flushable), feminine hygiene products, or harsh chemical cleaners into your system. These materials either clog the pipes, kill the beneficial bacteria in your tank, or damage the absorption field."},{"q":"Is a free camera inspection really included?","a":"Yes. Every service call from Discount Drain includes a free sewer video camera inspection, a $400 value at no charge. We show you the footage on-site so you can see exactly what is happening inside your pipes and tank before we recommend any work."},{"q":"How quickly can you respond to a septic emergency?","a":"We offer 24/7 emergency dispatch. For urgent situations such as sewage backup into the home or a fully blocked system, we prioritize same-day response. Call 519-451-8342 any time and our dispatch team will get a technician to you as quickly as possible."}]',
  metaTitle = 'Septic Service and Repairs London Ontario | Discount Drain',
  metaDesc = 'Professional septic service, repairs, and replacements in London and Southwestern Ontario. Free camera inspection included. 24/7 emergency dispatch. Call 519-451-8342.',
  featured = 1,
  sortOrder = 7
WHERE slug = 'septic-repairs';
